paragraphs: Mentioned in Demai, chapter 2, halakhah 1, reporting in the name of R' [Yose] ben Maadya.[^1]

notes.text: פ״ב ה״א explicitly gives chapter 2 halakhah 1; the Jerusalem Talmud is suggested by format but not explicitly stated or independently checked. The brackets around [Yose] belong to the supplied source; their authorship is not newly established. Maadya is a conventional transliteration of unvocalized מעדיה. Both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
